content:
According to tradition, users who post on X with the #AppleEvent hashtag in the coming days will see a custom Apple logo hashmoji appear on their posts. See below for details.

#AppleEvent hashmoji is now live on X

For years, whenever Apple holds a new event, the company launches a custom X hashmoji to match the occasion.

Following this morning's event invite — featuring an Apple-shaped halo around the sun and the tagline "Surprise and shine" — the company's new hashmoji is now live on X.

This means that when users post with #AppleEvent on the platform, they will see a custom Apple logo appear next to the hashtag, with a design adapted from the invite's artwork.

Apple's "Surprise and shine" event is scheduled for September 9 at 10 a.m. Pacific Time, and the company is expected to announce the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, along with its first foldable iPhone. There are also rumors of new Apple Watch and AirPods models.

Apple's hashmoji went live just hours after Greg Jozwiak, Apple's senior vice president of marketing, posted a teaser on X. Tim Cook subsequently reposted Jozwiak's post with his own comment.

Interestingly, some people interpreted Cook's mention of a "countdown" as an Easter egg hinting at his own countdown: he has just days left before stepping down as Apple CEO on September 1 to become the company's executive chairman.

9to5Mac will be at Apple Park on September 9 — stay tuned for our coverage before, during, and after the event.

Are you looking forward to this event? Let us know in the comments.
